Title: UmbraDesktop Entertainment
Description: Games and media for UmbraDesktop. An optional add-on that puts Minesweeper, Snake and umbraCoffee on the desktop, each in a window of its own and themed along with the rest of it.

AuthorDetails.Name: Luuk Peters
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer building packages that extend the CMS with enterprise-grade features.

RelatedPackages.Description: The desktop itself. This package is an add-on to it and installs it as a dependency; the desktop works on its own without the games.

Screenshots.Caption: Minesweeper in a window of its own, under the Windows 98 theme. It arrives in the launcher's Games group and gets a taskbar button like any other app.
Snake, the second game, under the same theme. Arrow keys to steer, a score and a best score, and it pauses itself when its window loses focus.
umbraCoffee while a show is live: the stream under player controls drawn in the style of the theme, with the live chat and the episode list in a side panel and a Remind me switch in the header.
umbraCoffee before the next show: a countdown with the start time written like the desktop's clock, a Remind me switch, and the episodes waiting in the side panel.
